column1: # THE REVIEW LEDGER (2026-09-21; COMPLETED.md s546). Read by Assets/Editor/ReviewLedgerCheck.cs (the cheap bar) and by Tools/bar_tier.ps1.
# A money path gets its adversarial review (s524's rule); c544620 (s539) touched one, the tier tool said REQUIRED, no review ran and a defect shipped.
# Since s546 the bar fails where a money path's STATE, a COMMIT's blob since the guard, or the BASELINE's digest has no row here.
# Columns, tab-separated: kind, key, sha256, status, date, record, evidence, note
#   key       the file's path, or the sentinel's seed
#   sha256    a file's state: SHA-256 of its bytes with every carriage return removed (working tree and blob are one state); a baseline: the sentinel's digest
#   status    reviewed       - an adversarial review ran on the CHANGE that left this state; evidence is the reviewer's report under Reviews/, and it names the file (or the digest).
#                              Nothing here claims a file was audited WHOLE: a row says the last change to it was read by an independent reader, which is what s524's rule asks
#             grandfathered  - the state the guard FOUND on 2026-09-21 and did not review; files only; the count is a ratchet (GrandfatheredCeiling) and only falls:
#                              when such a file is edited, its new state needs a reviewed row, this row is removed and the ceiling lowered
#   There is no waiver row. Reviewed rows are history and stay (the history pass looks up every commit since the guard). Add rows with Tools/review_row.ps1.
